scope: Read-only verification of 18 reference supports/limitations and current synthesis. No experiment reproduction, no exhaustive full-paper reading, no approval mutation. Query audit owned by parent reviewer.

findings.requiredRevision: Replace with 缺乏真实 OOD 边界监督，预测边界仍有误差, or add an independently verified small-object-specific source.

nonBlockingObservations.note: Main text says all22 available sequences; AppendixC.2 explicitly describes2train+19val. Production follows the concrete appendix construction and avoids repeating22, which is appropriate.

protocolAssessment: DriveOSS and TriO are correctly separated from official STU anomaly test ranking; code-based skip/distance distinctions and known-class/open-set metrics were independently read.

entries.assessment: 70 sequences, 68 staged and 2 natural; 19/51 split; ignore-class semantics; 50m manuscript bound and 2.5–50m code filters; both evaluators skip frames with <5 valid anomaly points; 5.17 AP/58.05 FPR95/8.81 PQ verified. UQ omits false positives.

Attention/logit prior, Perlin auxiliary OOD, soft void targets, EE, STU test 61.31/24.99/25.58 and other-structure/other-object definitions verified. Initial small-object wording was corrected and rechecked: the limitation now states OOD boundary errors, matching §4.7.

Confidence-weighted prototypes and contrastive/objectosphere heads with combined scores supported; ModelNet is evaluation construction, not OOD method training. STU test AP14.99 and nuScenes-OoD semantic loss 72.75/72.62 to 60.61/60.44 verified.

Relative positive/negative logit energy, road-point gathering/pulling/raising, mixed pretraining and one STU inlier adaptation sequence, unknown-category mismatch and complex geometry/sparsity limitations supported. Cached root directory has README and point_raise.py only. Journal full text remains unverified as production limitation already states.
Redundant classifier, resized known objects and calibration supported; original Table1 REAL AUPR20.8; category holdout differs from STU absent-in-training requirement.

Learned prototypes plus GAN-synthesized feature distribution; Euclidean/cosine hybrid criterion. Unknown other-vehicle on SemanticKITTI and window/sofa on S3DIS, not nuScenes; closed mIoU 58.0 to57.3 verified.

External ShapeNet, translation/rotation/resizing/ground placement and beam-compatible resampling supported; pointwise abstention and type-dependent penalty supported. Sparsity shortcut mitigation is not all-sensor elimination.

Diffusion semantic-feature reconstruction and density postprocessing supported. Minimum HDBSCAN cluster40, top40% score candidates and 0.7655s are explicit. Scores of unclustered/low-density candidates are reduced, not necessarily hard deleted; production sparse-object question is appropriately prospective. Current cached repository root has README only.
CARLA content/temporal anomaly construction, RGB/LiDAR/voxel labels, no-anomaly frames, one temporal anomaly type, quantization loss and sim2real limits supported. RADAR remains future work.
RGB/CARLA/G-buffer enhancement and T0 prediction versus T0+latency GT verified; temporal consistency evaluation exists. No real LiDAR or collision reduction conclusion inferred.

KITTI/nuScenes/ONCE and 34 classes supported; COMMON is model-relative subset, NOVEL remaining and CORNER union/class-agnostic. Production correctly distinguishes box-level corner cases from point-level LiDAR anomaly segmentation.
Modalities, corner-case levels and online criterion supported. Survey explicitly excludes sensor-layer faults; production uses survey to distinguish scopes, not as a 2026 saturation claim.

2D benchmark, proxy OoD choice, ROI/small-pixel filtering, component threshold calibration, downstream planning and edge efficiency supported. Saturation statement is bounded to the paper RGB benchmark context.
Three source classes, GT/context/licenses and sim2real/domain artifacts supported. Does not evaluate future STU models.
Auxiliary outlier dataset is disjoint from test-time OOD and fine-tuning encourages uniform posterior on auxiliary OOD. Production correctly bounds image/text evidence.
Direct stereo free-space/obstacle hypothesis tests, distance-adaptive DBSCAN and instance intersection versus false-positive Stixels/frame verified by reopening author PDF.
